evidence.reason: The wrapper advertises `typeof globalThis.fetch`, so its input type includes a native `Request`, but line 64 only casts the value for TypeScript and passes it unchanged to undici's `fetch`. Undici's runtime `RequestInfo` conversion does not treat a `globalThis.Request` as its own `Request`; it falls through to string conversion, losing the request URL/method/headers/body and producing `[object Request]` or a URL parse failure. String and URL inputs are unaffected, but this is an ordinary correctness defect in the intended fetch-compatible behavior.
